job.job_description:
About Us

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 400,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of Americas leading retailers. Joining Target means promoting a culture of mutual care and respect and striving to make the most meaningful and positive impact. Becoming a Target team member means joining a community that values different voices and lifts each other up. Here, we believe your unique perspective is important, and youll build relationships by being authentic and respectful.

Overview about TII

At Target, we have a timeless purpose and a proven strategy. And that hasn t happened by accident. Some of the best minds from different backgrounds come together at Target to redefine retail in an inclusive learning environment that values people and delivers world-class outcomes. That winning formula is especially apparent in Bengaluru, where Target in India operates as a fully integrated part of Target s global team and has more than 4,000 team members supporting the company s global strategy and operations.

About position: Position Overview

As an Engineer focused on Developer Productivity and DevEx, you will take a hands-on software development role in building, maintaining, and supporting our long-term software delivery fabric. With your technical skills and developer empathy, you will help write the code that creates a proactive, secure, and flexible environment where software and dev box provisioning is invisible, governed, and highly intelligent.

You will contribute directly to a greenfield software delivery ecosystem similar to Workbrew that serves two distinct, high-impact cohorts: this project s macOS-based builder community and the Linux-based automated agents operating in the CI/CD pipeline. You will help tackle complex software supply chain challenges, building automated threat screening integrations, package quarantine loops, and robust telemetry data pipelines that ensure total visibility across our technical landscape. You will partner with various teams and stakeholders and collaborate with engineering partners to grow your skills while shaping this project s developer platform

How You Can Make an Impact

Build and Maintain: Develop, test, and maintain key features of a unified, greenfield software delivery platform that provides a reviewed, governed Golden Path for software consumption across the company.

Support Tooling Ergonomics: Prioritize the developer experience by contributing to clean, ergonomic interfaces and CLI tools that serve as an intuitive safety net rather than a source of friction.

Implement Supply Chain Defense: Code automated security guardrails, including version cooldown periods and strict quarantine rules, to detect and block supply chain attacks before code enters production environments.

Maintain Telemetry Data Pipelines: Build and maintain telemetry pipelines to track asset distribution and version drift, streaming data cleanly into our enterprise data stack including Snowflake, Datadog, and Prometheus.

Apply Technical Governance: Write code to help translate the corporate Tech Radar tiers (Adopt, Trial, Assess, Hold) into real-time, automated platform enforcements.

Collaborate Effectively: Work closely within the team and with adjacent engineering partners to align daily engineering tasks with organizational threat-screening and compliance standards.

Learn and Craft: Participate in code reviews, adopt system design best practices, to support high-quality software craftsmanship and platform empathy.

About You

Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

2+ years of professional software development experience, with exposure to Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, SRE, or Developer Experience roles.

Strong developer empathy and an interest in designing highly ergonomic internal developer tools, CLI interfaces, or APIs, or shared libraries.

Proficiency in at least one programming language used for infrastructure and tooling, such as Golang or Python.

Foundational understanding of macOS and Linux operating system environments, alongside experience using multi-language package management systems such as Homebrew, pip, and npm.

Exposure to data engineering concepts, including writing queries or handling data schemas for platforms like Snowflake, Datadog, or Prometheus.

Basic understanding of Software Supply Chain Security concepts such as dependency vulnerability management and package patching.

Good communication and team collaboration skills, with a commitment to providing high-quality visibility and tools for engineering teams.

Nice to Have

Familiarity with environments that utilize LLM-based assistants or automated agents for system configuration and code generation.

Exposure to containerized environments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud-native environments like AWS or GCP.
